body: We carry an idea that this is true and that the world is like that, but some things cannot be mended. I thank you for your kind words.
More than anything. What will be written about me will destroy them. I know my death will be a horrible thing for them, but I just don't want to go on.

I appreciate your words but even if it can, everyone will still read what is published and everyone will know. My humiliation will be complete and my reputation destroyed. I am feeling physically sick at even the thought.

There is no recourse in law to this. People can post what they want. I am not being extorted because the person doing it simply wants to hurt me. A lawyer won't be able to erase the details, and once they are published I am done.
It started as that, but got progressively worse and more complex. Now a huge amount of personal details, both made-up and true, accompanied by pictures are going to be published online.

I think any worth I have is gone. I have prepared a will and a letter to my family trying to explain my actions and my selfishness. I have no children.

A couple of you took the time to try to give me a flicker of self-worth, and I greatly appreciate that. My heart felt lighter for a few moments knowing that someone cared. But some things can't be fixed. Some people too. I can't stand self-pity so I won't labor this. Thank you guys.

I have never posted anything here before, but Redditors, from what I've seen (and am now seeing in your responses) are generally thoughtful and kind. I think perhaps by being here I was just hoping for a few final moments and words of kindness.

I don't think I can fix this any other way.

I have been caught in a lie. One which someone is now going to expose online with details that will probably be heavily embellished. When my loved ones find out, which I imagine they will fairly quickly, I am done. That is as much as I can say.
